title: 2 Secrets Hidden Inside the Ford GT
description:
The Ford GT is one of the most exclusive American cars ever built. About one thousand three hundred fifty were made, buyers had to apply just to be allowed to buy one, and it won its class at Le Mans in its very first try. But two secrets about this car are almost never told. One is about a door. The other is about what this car did to Porsche. Here is the hint. The Ford GT was designed behind a door that looked like a broom cupboard, by a team that started without permission from Ford's own bosses. And once it hit the race track, it was so effective that Porsche reportedly redesigned its most famous race car. Both stories are documented, and both are true.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
